title: The evolution of AI: From 2019 to 2024 and its impact on innovation
excerpt: Join us at 1682 and explore the ever-changing landscape of innovation programs, with a particular focus on the real-world applications of AI.

children.text: The period between 2019 and 2024 has seen remarkable advancements in the technology and innovation. Since
the last 1682 Conference in 2019

, the world has experienced a technological renaissance. The integration of AI into everyday business operations has transformed how companies interact with their customers and employees. From sophisticated chatbots and virtual assistants to predictive analytics and personalized marketing, AI has enabled organizations to deliver more efficient, tailored, and proactive customer service.

When we look at large organizations, many brands are still getting their feet on the ground to implement innovation practices. Although some industries may be slower to adopt than others, this shift has not only improved customer satisfaction but also streamlined internal processes, leading to more agile and innovative business models.

, industry leaders will explore how AI is driving opportunities inside their organizations, but also, how they’re determining if it’s impacting a return on its investment.

AI: Then vs now

In 2019, AI was a niche technology with limited applications and accessibility, predominantly used by large corporations for specialized tasks. However, today’s AI landscape today is vastly different, with widespread integration, advanced capabilities, and increased accessibility across businesses of all sizes. This evolution has made AI a fundamental part of organizational strategies, driving innovation and operational efficiency. Microsoft President Brad Smith has even
compared the development of artificial intelligence (AI) to the printing press
AI in 2019

Limited applications: AI was primarily used in specialized fields like data analysis, automation of routine tasks, and basic customer service through chatbots.
Cost and accessibility: High costs and limited access to advanced technology made AI adoption feasible only for large corporations.
Data dependency: AI systems relied heavily on structured data, making it necessary for organizations to have extensive and well-organized datasets.
AI in 2024
Widespread adoption: AI is now integrated across various business functions, including marketing, sales, customer service, and operations.
Increased accessibility: Advances in AI technology and reduced costs have made AI tools accessible to small and medium-sized businesses.
Advanced capabilities: Modern AI can handle unstructured data, such as text, images, and videos, allowing for more sophisticated analysis and applications.

Autonomy and efficiency: AI systems have become more autonomous, requiring less human intervention and increasing operational efficiency.
O3 is driving AI projects across sectors

The rapid expansion and adoption of AI have been pivotal for our team since 2019, generating a wide breadth of projects across various industries. As brands increasingly embrace AI, they are reimagining their projects and processes to enhance efficiency and deliver superior customer experiences.
Check out two innovation and AI projects we have been working on…
Implementing AI across healthcare institutions

For the last 6 years, O3 has partnered with a major healthcare institution’s innovation group to improve processes and enhance patient experiences. Through this engagement, we’ve helped transform internal innovation processes, test and validate 10 different digital product concepts. This collaboration not only improved their approach to innovating patient care but also led to a partnership to launch one of those products with a Fortune 100 company.
Revolutionizing the creative gig economy with generative AI

O3 partnered with REC to develop Scarlet AI, a unique virtual assistant that revolutionizes the creative gig economy. The product delivers a deeply personalized and engaging experience, seamlessly managing information and bookings for REC members.
